# Moss Adams

> Moss Adams is a leading integrated professional services firm providing accounting, consulting, tax planning, and wealth management across 20+ specialized industries.

Moss Adams serves over 4,100 healthcare clients, 1,200 financial services clients, and hundreds of companies across aerospace, construction, energy, food & beverage, and other sectors. The firm specializes in regulatory compliance, transaction planning, cybersecurity services, and tax optimization strategies including ERC, R&D Tax Credits, and cost segregation.

## Key Topics

- Accounting Services
- Tax Compliance & Planning
- Cybersecurity Services
- Industry Expertise
- Mergers & Acquisitions
- Succession Planning
- Employee Retention Credit (ERC)
- R&D Tax Credits
- Cost Segregation
- CMMC Compliance
- CHIPS Act
- Regulatory Compliance
- Transaction Planning
- Wealth Management
- Financial Services
